name: Jim Lahey's No-Knead Pizza Dough

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour, plus more for shaping the dough

instructions.primary_message: In a medium bowl, thoroughly blend flour, yeast, and salt. Add water and, with a wooden spoon or your hands, mix thoroughly.

Cover bowl with plastic wrap or a kitchen towel and allow it to rise at room temperature (about 22°C/22°C) for 18 hours or until it has more than doubled. It will take longer in a chilly room and less time in a very warm one.

Flour a work surface and scrape out the dough. Divide it into 4 equal parts and shape them: For each portion, start with the right side of the dough and pull it toward the center; then do the same with the left, then the top, then the bottom. (The order doesn’t actually matter; what you want is four folds.) Shape each portion into a round and turn seam side down. Mold dough into a neat circular mound. The mounds should not be sticky; if they are, dust with more flour.

If you don’t intend to use the dough right away, wrap the balls individually in plastic and refrigerate for up to 3 days. Return to room temperature by leaving them out on the counter, covered in a damp cloth, for 2 to 3 hours before needed.

description: Just mix flour, salt, and yeast, add water, stir it all together, then let it sit in a covered bowl for eight or nine hours. That's the trick to Jim Lahey's no-knead pizza dough.
notes: Total time, including resting: 18 hr 10 min.
author: J. Kenji López-Alt
